turns.assessment: The failure is localized to the S04 line interface for lightpath och178. It raised an explicit EQPT_CARD_FAIL at the same instant that all services carried by och178 failed, while the far-end S14 interface reported OCH_LOS and lost received power. Unchanged amplifier telemetry and unaffected services on other S04 paths strongly argue against an OMS, fibre, amplifier, or ROADM-wide fault.

proposals.rationale: The S04 och178 line interface raised EQPT_CARD_FAIL at t=602.5. A card failure explains loss of its transmitted channel at S14, loss of locally received traffic at S04, and the simultaneous interruption of every service using och178 in both directions.
A failed S04 transmitter could explain the S14 OCH_LOS and lost channel power, but it would not adequately explain the explicit card-failure alarm or failure of traffic received at S04.
